reviews.author: Seth S.
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying this is a beautiful place. Nothing can diminish that, except persistent winds, and when the wind dies down in summer plenty of bugs.
I like it in fall, when the colors really come out. Sadly, the campground with the best colors usually closes at the peak of said colors.
My current gripe is more of a system wide complaint - the new system the state parks are using is flawed. We are talking about an electronic (database) system for reservations and registration. The idea is great - reservations up until like 2pm, then FCFS registration afterwards.
The reality sucks. It is NOT functioning right. 3 times in one 5 day trip at 3 different state parks the system failed to work for me.
You are supposed to call and register for your site if you have been unable to make a reservation. What happened to me is that they were unable each time to register me for the open spot of my choosing.
It is ridiculous. Fortunately, at the other 2 state parks, there were staff around to sort things out. Not so at Lake Wenatchee.
Then, their instructions clearly stated NOT to put money in a registratiin envelope, rather to square up at the booth. But the booth is closed for the season. And the ranger I finally discussed this with offered no solution besides call the phone number, which did not solve the problem.
Finally a maintenance worker told me I could put cash in the envelope, so I did.
I really hope they figure this out. At one of the other campgrounds, I got a look at their system in action - they could not put me in my site for another night until refreshing the page multiple times. Could be a very fun camping season at Washington State Parks.
Word of wisdom: bring cash, and you still can put it in an envelope, maybe.

reviews.author: Mark P.
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful lakes I’ve ever seen. The trails around the park were clearly marked and very scenic. I would love to spend more time here.

reviews.author: Dyanne G.
reviews.text:
Unfortunately due to some car issues we didn’t get to spend as much time at the lake as we wanted to. But we did make it up in the late afternoon and I could tell instantly that this would be a wonderful area to have a picnic at. We only visited the beach area but there were plenty of picnic benches both on the beach and in the wooded areas. The view across the lake was majestic and the bathroom facilities were clean and stocked.
Bonus points for having a wheelchair mat down to the water making this mobility challenge friendly

reviews.author: Marisa L.
reviews.text: Went camping with my husband and two dogs here for the first time. This is the lake that faced my fears. I finally went out on a kayak with my husband! Best choice ever. We will be back! Great camping for children! This camp will keep your kids busy all day!

reviews.author: Julia P.
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning views! Great place for a stroll outdoors after stopping by Leavenworth. Ample parking space, a boat launch area, warming cabin, campground, playground, and plenty of tables for picnicking.
